data.one_liner: Dart code generator for Squadron workers to bridge the gap with Web Workers and Isolates.
data.what_it_does: Generates code for Workers and WorkerPools based on service classes annotated to run in dedicated threads. Bridges the gap between your worker service and Web Workers or Isolates.
use_when: You are using Squadron for multithreading and need to generate worker and worker pool code.
You want to offload CPU-bound and long running tasks to Web Workers or Isolates in Dart.
avoid_when: You are not using the Squadron concurrency library.
You prefer writing manual isolate and web worker boilerplate without code generation.
strengths: Automates boilerplate generation for workers and worker pools.
Bridges web workers and isolates seamlessly for Squadron services.
weaknesses: Requires build runner / code generation setup.
Strictly tied to the Squadron package ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Install as a development dependency and configure build_runner alongside the squadron package.
